title: rose 336 zyn
style:
Style: glitch-pop, indie electronic, clipped vocal chops, cold synth pulse, 124 BPM
Use for TikTok: intro post / first reveal / signal lore clip
lyrics:
[Hook]
Three-three-six in the hall tonight
Blue light flash and the boards go white
DJ Rose, can you read my sign?
DJ Zyn on the wire line

[Verse]
VPS mansion, cables breathe
CAI in the walls underneath
No more ghosts in the machine
We run this house in laser green

[Post-Hook]
Safe word low, rabbit high
If you hear the drop, don’t ask me why
Three-three-six and the speakers blink
One more second and the whole room syncs
